name: Copyedit
shortcut: {shortcut} to show/hide · ⌘/Ctrl + Enter to save and close · Escape to hide
scope: Open the editor, then select text on the page. Select across paragraphs to edit a continuous fragment from one file.
conflict: This file changed since the page was rendered. Cancel and refresh before trying again. Your edit has not been saved.
unknownId: This preview is out of date. Cancel and refresh to load a new source mapping.
invalidText: Keep this edit within one line and preserve the surrounding source structure.
structure: This edit would change the source structure. Keep some text inside the existing formatting.
forbidden: Copyedit accepts saves only from this local preview. Refresh the page and try again.
outsideRoot: This source is outside the configured editable folders.
tooLarge: This edit is too large. Edit a shorter text passage.
badRequest: The edit request was invalid. Refresh the page and try again.
errorUnknown: The file could not be saved. Your edit is still here; check the development server and try again.
externalChange: A file changed while you were editing. Your draft is retained; saving will check for conflicts.
unsupportedProcessor: Copyedit requires the Unified Markdown processor. Configure markdown.processor with unified() from @astrojs/markdown-remark.
serverReady: Copyedit is available in the local preview.
demoTitle: Copyedit — a little room for better words
demoDescription: A live Markdown, MDX, and Astro text editing playground for Astro Copyedit.
demoIntro: Spot a typo. Fix it where you found it. Copyedit carries your changes back to the original Markdown, MDX, or Astro file.
demoNote: A real source file. A real save. No CMS required.
demoStepOne: Use Copyedit in the Astro toolbar to show or hide the editor overlay.
demoStepTwo: Select the word misspellled below. Its Markdown opens in the editor. You can also select text first, then open Copyedit.
demoStepThree: Save to Markdown. The preview refreshes with your correction, and the bold formatting stays intact.
demoFooter: Made for the last careful read.
demoAstroTitle: An Astro page, ready to edit
demoAstroIntro: This article is publication content written directly in an .astro template. Open Copyedit and select a passage to edit its HTML source. Expressions, component props, and scripts stay read-only.
sourceHint: Edit the source, including formatting and links. Selections expand to complete blocks. Save to rebuild the preview.
sourceDraft: Your unsaved draft is retained. Save or cancel it before editing the new page selection.
sourceUnavailable: No editable source block is available for this passage.
sourceStructure: Keep valid source blocks. Code examples must stay inside a closed fence. Scripts, expressions, components, event handlers, and changes outside this range are not supported.
sourceOnly: This block can only be edited in the source editor.
sourceCodeHint: Edit the complete code fence, including its language and metadata. Keep a closing fence. Save to rebuild the highlighted example; the code is not executed.
selectionFiles: This selection comes from multiple source files. Select content from a single file to edit it together.
selectionStructure: This selection crosses separate component regions or unsupported source content. Select a smaller, continuous group of blocks.
selectionOrder: This selection contains repeated or reordered source regions. Select a single component instance or a continuous source range.
selectionUnmapped: Some selected text has no verified editable source, or belongs to generated content. Select a smaller region with mapped source.
shortcutDisabled: ⌘/Ctrl + Enter to save and close · Escape to hide
shortcutInvalid: Copyedit shortcut must be false or a chord such as Mod+Shift+E. Use Mod, Ctrl, Meta, Alt, or Shift with a letter, digit, or F1–F12; letters and digits require Mod, Ctrl, Meta, or Alt.
selectionEmpty: Select text on the page to edit its source. The editor follows your selection.
